bug_semantics: SctpSackChunk.ParseChunk reads attacker-controlled numGapAckBlocks and numDuplicateTSNs (each up to 65535) and loops that many times calling NetConvert.ParseUInt16/32 with no check of the counts against the declared chunk length or the 262144-byte reused recvBuffer. A checksum-valid SACK with chunkLength=16 and count 0xFFFF walks past the buffer, raising IndexOutOfRangeException. That SystemException skips RTCSctpTransport.DoReceive catch (ApplicationException) continue and hits catch (Exception) break, so the once-started SCTP receive thread exits with no restart and all data channels die (CWE-125/CWE-755). Below the buffer bound the same loops silently parse leftover bytes as gap/dup reports.
